question.knowledge_point: Calculating the Cross Product of Two Vectors Whose Angle Is a Non-Special Angle
question.problem: The vector $u$ has magnitude $7$, the vector $v$ has magnitude $7,$ the angle between $u$ and $v$ is ${117}^{∘}$ and $n$ is the unit vector that points in the direction of $u\times v.$ Find $u\times v$ in terms of $n.$ Round your final answer to one decimal place where appropriate.
question.worked_solution:
We use the formula for the cross product and obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}u\times v & =|u|\cdot |v|\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡\theta \cdot n \\  & =7\cdot 7\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡{117}^{∘}\cdot n \\  & =49\cdot (0.891\,00…)\cdot n \\  & =(43.659\,31…)\cdot n \\  & ≈43.7n.\end{aligned}
$$
